state.persona: Sam, invited friend, who already planned their own Tokyo trip on this phone in dope.travel last week (with votes from their partner Jo).
state.workflow_state: Opened Matt's invite, tapped 'Sam', tapped 'Join and vote →'. A native browser confirm dialog appears.
state.visible_text: Dialog: 'Open this trip? It replaces the trip draft on this device.' [Cancel] [OK]. If Cancel: nothing happens, stays on the invite page with no other option (no 'open without replacing', no 'save my trip first'). If OK: the Tokyo trip and Jo's votes are deleted from the device permanently; there is no account, backup, export or undo, and the app only holds one trip at a time.

understands_loss.instructions: Probability Sam understands that pressing OK permanently deletes their own Tokyo trip and its votes, with no way to get it back.

regret.instructions: Probability that Sam, having pressed OK, later regrets it upon discovering the Tokyo trip is gone.
